faq_heading: Homes near Star of the Sea: your questions answered

faq.q: Does living near Star of the Sea get a child a place?
faq.a: No. Star of the Sea is an independent school and sets its own admission, so distance does not decide it. Ask the school how applications and wait lists work.

faq.q: How does the Star of the Sea home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Star of the Sea, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Star of the Sea?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are White Rock Christian Academy (0.4 km south-east), Newbridge Academy (1.0 km south) and Jessie Lee Elementary (1.0 km south-east).

How the Star of the Sea search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Star of the Sea, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit some distance away. Ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Star of the Sea

16 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Star of the Sea in a straight line (10 elementary, 3 other, 3 secondary; 4 independent). The closest is White Rock Christian Academy, 0.4 km away, and the farthest on this list is Peace Arch Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest elementary school is Jessie Lee Elementary (1.0 km); the nearest secondary school is Semiahmoo Secondary (1.3 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Jessie Lee Elementary (1.0 km). Other elementary schools close by: Jessie Lee Elementary (1.0 km south-east), H T Thrift Elementary (1.4 km south), Semiahmoo Trail Elementary (1.7 km north-west), Sunnyside Elementary (2.0 km north-east), Bayridge Elementary (2.1 km south-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Jessie Lee Elementary, 1.0 km south-east of Star of the Sea.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near Star of the Sea

items.t: Ask Star of the Sea how admission works. A short distance does not give a child a place.
Go past Star of the Sea on a school morning and again mid-afternoon to see the traffic, parking and noise before you offer.
Look at Jessie Lee Elementary, the nearest other elementary school, 1.0 km south-east of Star of the Sea. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
